Educational information only. This tool cannot diagnose allergy, assess severity, or decide whether a food is safe for you. For breathing difficulty, throat swelling, faintness, or widespread hives, seek emergency medical care.
Cross-reactivity means proteins are similar enough that the immune system may react to both. It does not mean that everyone allergic to one will react to the other.
